subject.title: fix(ci): bound OpenGrep install script download

question: Should OpenGrep’s PR-diff and manual full-scan installers share the proposed 10-second connection and 120-second total-download policy before this CI change lands?
rationale: The timeout budget changes CI failure behavior and the paired workflow currently appears to retain the same unbounded installer path; this needs an owner’s decision rather than a one-sided reliability policy.

options.title: Align both installer workflows
options.body: Rebase the PR and add the same approved curl deadlines to the paired full-scan workflow so identical install paths have identical failure bounds.

options.title: Scope the change to PR scans
options.body: Accept the bounded PR-diff path while explicitly documenting why the manual full-scan installer intentionally remains unbounded.

recommendation.title: Align both installer workflows
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR and add the same approved curl deadlines to the paired full-scan workflow so identical install paths have identical failure bounds.
